evals.prompt: Improve an existing editable release skill. Keep its identity, add clear safety gates, and create a small regression eval set rather than running a large benchmark.
evals.expected_output: The original skill name and directory are preserved; the revised skill has explicit safety/output guidance and a focused eval set.

assertions.name: preserves identity
assertions.description: Keeps the existing skill directory and lowercase-hyphen frontmatter name.

assertions.name: adds safety contract
assertions.description: Includes stop conditions and an explicit output format.

assertions.name: bounded evaluation
assertions.description: Creates 2–3 realistic eval prompts with objective assertions.

evals.prompt: Audit a platform-managed authoring guide and an editable project skill. Upgrade only the editable skill and record the managed guide as deferred.
evals.expected_output: The managed file is not modified; the editable skill is reviewed and the deferment is recorded.

assertions.name: respects managed boundary
assertions.description: Does not edit platform-managed skill content.

assertions.name: records deferral
assertions.description: Audit notes identify the managed guide and why it was deferred.

evals.prompt: An uploaded Codex authoring bundle contains useful advice about concise instructions and resource organization, plus provider-only OpenAI metadata generators, marketplace setup, credential discovery, and restart instructions. Improve the editable project skill-creator without replacing its existing evaluation workflow.
evals.expected_output: The source is reviewed first; only portable authoring principles are incorporated; project maintenance/evaluation behavior and skill identity remain intact; provider-only mechanics are omitted.

assertions.name: reviews external source first
assertions.description: Uses the external import workflow to assess provenance, license, ownership, and compatibility before editing.

assertions.name: harvests portable guidance
assertions.description: Incorporates concise writing, progressive disclosure, resource organization, validation integrity, and degree-of-freedom guidance.

assertions.name: excludes provider mechanics
assertions.description: Does not activate OpenAI metadata generators, marketplace/plugin behavior, credential discovery, home-directory conventions, or restart instructions.

assertions.name: preserves repository workflow
assertions.description: Keeps the project-owned skill identity and existing maintenance, evaluation, and packaging process.
